historyReduction.description: One real Wasm engine, history capacity 20, cycles through Link apply/undo/redo, forward/backward cut, caret move, typing, and six undo/redo operations. The production projection and selection adapters consume each generated view once. Every transition checks text, Highlight, both Link properties including false, and selection coordinates.
schedules: one task yield after each cycle
limits: No DOM, renderer, toolbar, queue, copy serialization or clipboard echo events are present.
Deletion and typing use core actions directly. This is a reduction, not an exact reproduction of browser routing or handle lifetimes.
Passing cannot prove that browser event handling is necessary for the original intermittent fault.

fixtureCorrection.description: The initial Chromium run incorrectly expected redo-cut to restore offset 0. The actual caret is offset 9: the intervening state-only caret move updates the cut entry's after-boundary. The probe expectation was corrected, not the production core.

All other rejection sites, successful predicates and production code remain unchanged. This is not a byte-identical reconstruction of every older diagnostic module.
